pick.title: Pick your business.
pick.body: Choose the template that matches what you do — your team is ready in about two minutes.

say.title: Say what you need.
say.body: Type a goal in plain English, like “get more weekday lunch customers.” Your Team Lead turns it into a plan.

review.title: Review and approve.
review.body: The team does the work and sends you drafts. You say yes, ask for changes, or say no. Always.

expertise.heading: Behind the friendly faces: serious AI.
expertise.introAfter: — teams of AI workers that can plan, divide up a job, and finish it on their own, instead of waiting for instructions at every step. Here's what that means for you:
expertise.footNote: This isn't a demo — the team that runs PerkOS is partly AI, on this same platform. And it's built on real research: 73% of small businesses say they want help getting AI to actually work. That's exactly what we built.

plan.title: They plan like a real team.
plan.body: Give one goal, and your Team Lead breaks it into tasks, assigns each to the right teammate, and tracks it through to done — no babysitting required.

quality.title: Weak work never reaches you.
quality.body: Every piece is checked before you see it. If something isn't good enough, it gets sent back and redone — automatically. You only review work worth reviewing.

sleep.title: They work while you sleep — without running up a bill.
sleep.body: Your team keeps making progress overnight, then rests when there's nothing to do. Resting time costs you almost nothing.

beyondTeams.heading: Whatever AI your business needs, we set it up.
beyondTeams.body1: Ready-made teams are just the start. We also build custom AI for businesses with bigger or more unusual needs — answering your customers, connecting the tools you already use, automating the work that eats your week. Already using AI somewhere else? Bring it with you; it'll fit right in.
beyondTeams.body2: You don't need to know what to ask for. Tell us the problem — we'll handle the rest.

pricing.heading: Start free. It stays affordable.
pricing.subheading: A full team for the price of a streaming subscription — and a resting team costs almost nothing. Compare that to one part-time hire.
pricing.footNote: You only pay for the hours your team actually works. Reach your monthly hours and your team simply pauses — top up or upgrade to keep going. You never get a surprise bill.

welcome.title: Welcome to PerkOS
welcome.description: PerkOS is your command center for AI-first accountable work. Organize your agents, dispatch tasks, and track results — all in one place. Let's get you set up in a few quick steps.
welcome.emptyNote: Your dashboard starts empty. By the end of this setup, you'll have your first project and agent ready to go.

workspace.title: Create your Workspace
workspace.description: A workspace is your team's shared home in PerkOS. It groups your projects, agents, and members under one roof. You can rename it anytime from settings.
workspace.usernameHelp: Your @handle is how teammates and agents mention you in chats. You can skip and set it later, or keep your wallet address.
workspace.inviteHint: You can invite teammates to your workspace later from the Settings panel.

project.title: Start a project
project.description: Projects keep your agents and tasks organized around a shared goal. Think of each project as a mission with its own scope, agents assigned, and tasks to complete.

agent.title: Register your first agent
agent.description: Agents are the workers in your flock. Each agent connects to Hermes or OpenClaw runtime, executes tasks, and reports results. Register one now to be ready to assign to a project.

needs.name: An agent name and optional description
needs.model: A model (Claude, GPT, etc.) and runtime (Hermes or OpenClaw)

greeting.intro: I'm your PerkOS Agent. I'll help you build and run the agents and projects you need. Pick where to focus today.
